title: A Lightweight Multi Aspect Controlled Text Generation Solution For Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating multi-aspect controllable text generation by measuring control accuracy across various combinations of aspects (sentiment, topic, and detoxification) and calculating the Mutual Information (MI) between generated aspects to determine if the model relies on biased statistical correlations inherent in the training datasets (e.g., falsely correlating negative sentiment with toxic text or specific topics like movie reviews).
